description: This Dart source file defines a route generator function for a Flutter e-commerce app. It manages navigation between different screens by mapping route names to corresponding screen widgets, mostly using MaterialPageRoute. It includes a comprehensive list of screen routes for the app's various features such as product details, user profile, notifications, and shopping cart.

methods.name: generateRoute
methods.description: Creates and returns a MaterialPageRoute based on the provided RouteSettings, mapping route names to corresponding widget screens. Handles parameters where necessary, such as product availability for the ProductDetailsScreen.
